tv_wonder_set_required_progress_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_unit_required_progress value = 300000 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_required_progress
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_required_progress target = var:tv_wonder_locked }
		}
		set_local_variable = {
			name = tv_wonder_required_progress
			value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_required_progress|var:tv_wonder_locked)"
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_unit_required_progress value = local_var:tv_wonder_required_progress }
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_required_progress
	}
}

tv_wonder_remove_current_priority_candidate_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner }
		scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_priority_site
			has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
			has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:tv_wonder_priority_next_candidate_id ?= { this >= 1 } } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_next_candidate_id value = 1 }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = var:tv_wonder_priority_next_candidate_id }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_next_candidate_id add = 1 }
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = scope:tv_wonder_priority_site }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode }
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id
	}
}

tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_owner
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_matches
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_priority_site
			has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_target_candidate_wonder_id value = var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id }
		every_key_in_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id
			set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = this }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
					}
				}
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
					set_local_variable = {
						name = tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id
						value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id|local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id)"
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { local_var:tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id < local_var:tv_wonder_priority_target_candidate_wonder_id }
						NOT = { local_var:tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id > local_var:tv_wonder_priority_target_candidate_wonder_id }
					}
					scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = { remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_matches }
					scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
						"variable_map(tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id|local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id)" = {
							if = {
								limit = { this = scope:tv_wonder_priority_site }
								scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_matches value = 1 } }
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_matches } }
						tv_wonder_remove_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = { remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_matches }
					}
				}
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id
			}
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id
		}
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_target_candidate_wonder_id
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_matches
}

tv_wonder_select_saved_priority_proposal_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_found
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_proposal_site
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_proposal_mode
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_random_candidate_id
	clear_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_valid_candidate_deck
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_owner
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_declined }
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id
			has_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id
		}
		every_key_in_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id
			set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = this }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
					}
				}
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
					set_local_variable = {
						name = tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id
						value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id|local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id)"
					}
				}
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id }
					remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_valid
					remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
				}
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
					"variable_map(tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id|local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id)" = {
						save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
						tv_wonder_validate_priority_candidate_for_saved_wonder_effect = yes
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_valid } }
					scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
						remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_valid_candidate_deck key = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = 1 }
					}
				}
				else = {
					tv_wonder_remove_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
				}
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
					remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_valid
					remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
					remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
				}
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id
			}
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_valid_candidate_deck }
		random_key_in_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_priority_valid_candidate_deck
			scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_random_candidate_id value = prev }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_random_candidate_id }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id value = var:tv_wonder_priority_random_candidate_id }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id }
				}
			}
			scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id
					value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_by_id|local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id)"
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode
					value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode_by_id|local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id)"
				}
				"variable_map(tv_wonder_priority_candidate_site_by_id|local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id)" = {
					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal value = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal_mode value = local_var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_found value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal_site value = scope:tv_wonder_priority_site }
				tv_wonder_set_proposal_on_great_engineer_effect = yes
			}
		}
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_mode
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_saved_candidate_wonder_id
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_id
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_random_candidate_id
	clear_variable_map = tv_wonder_priority_valid_candidate_deck
}

tv_wonder_construct_module_for_last_completed_part_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
			var:tv_wonder_last_completed_part ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_wonder_last_completed_part ?= { this <= 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_wonder_last_completed_part ?= 1
				has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type target = var:tv_wonder_locked }
			}
			set_local_variable = {
				name = tv_wonder_module_building_type
				value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type|var:tv_wonder_locked)"
			}
			save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
			var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
				if = {
					limit = { always = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type } }
						construct_building = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
					}
					else = {
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type
							value = 1
							owner = prev
						}
					}
				}
			}
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_module_building_type
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_wonder_last_completed_part ?= 2
				has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_body_module_building_type
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_body_module_building_type target = var:tv_wonder_locked }
			}
			set_local_variable = {
				name = tv_wonder_module_building_type
				value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_body_module_building_type|var:tv_wonder_locked)"
			}
			save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
			var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
				if = {
					limit = { always = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type } }
						construct_building = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
					}
					else = {
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type
							value = 1
							owner = prev
						}
					}
				}
			}
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_module_building_type
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_wonder_last_completed_part ?= 3
				has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_function_module_building_type

							set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_body_units value = 4 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { var:tv_wonder_function_units < 4 }
							set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_function_units value = 4 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { var:tv_wonder_decoration_units < 4 }
							set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_decoration_units value = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_style_3_final_building_type value >= 5 } }
					prev = {
						if = {
							limit = { var:tv_wonder_foundation_units < 5 }
							set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_foundation_units value = 5 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { var:tv_wonder_body_units < 5 }
							set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_body_units value = 5 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { var:tv_wonder_function_units < 5 }
							set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_function_units value = 5 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { var:tv_wonder_decoration_units < 5 }
							set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_decoration_units value = 5 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_style_3_final_building_type value >= 6 } }

						}
						if = {

						}
						if = {

						}
						if = {
							limit = { var:tv_wonder_decoration_units < 6 }
							set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_decoration_units value = 6 }
						}
					}
				}

		}

			}
			if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type value >= 2 } }

			}
			if = {
				limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type value >= 6 } }
				prev = { change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_foundation_units add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_foundation_units min = 0 max = 6 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = tv_wonder_body_module_building_type
			value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_body_module_building_type|var:tv_wonder_locked)"

tv_wonder_detect_existing_wonder_at_saved_site_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_existing_found
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_existing_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id
					has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style
				}
				ordered_key_in_global_variable_map = {
					variable = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id
					max = 2000
					limit = {
						NOT = { scope:tv_wonder_existing_owner = { has_variable = tv_wonder_existing_found } }
						is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style target = this }
						prev = { has_building = prev }
					}
					set_local_variable = {
						name = tv_wonder_existing_wonder_id
						value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id|this)"
					}
					set_local_variable = {
						name = tv_wonder_existing_ritual_style
						value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style|this)"
					}
					scope:tv_wonder_existing_owner = {
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked value = local_var:tv_wonder_existing_wonder_id }
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_style value = local_var:tv_wonder_existing_ritual_style }
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_locked value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_existing_found value = 1 }
					}
					remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_existing_ritual_style
					remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_existing_wonder_id
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_intermediate_building_type_to_wonder_id }
				ordered_key_in_global_variable_map = {
					variable = tv_wonder_intermediate_building_type_to_wonder_id
					max = 2000
					limit = {
						NOT = { scope:tv_wonder_existing_owner = { has_variable = tv_wonder_existing_found } }
						prev = { has_building = prev }
					}
					set_local_variable = {
						name = tv_wonder_existing_wonder_id
						value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_intermediate_building_type_to_wonder_id|this)"
					}
					scope:tv_wonder_existing_owner = {
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked value = local_var:tv_wonder_existing_wonder_id }
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_existing_found value = 1 }
					}
					remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_existing_wonder_id
				}
			}
		}
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_existing_found
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_apply_helper_building_to_final_site_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_helper_building_type
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_helper_building_type target = var:tv_wonder_locked }
		}
		set_local_variable = {
			name = tv_wonder_helper_building_type
			value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_helper_building_type|var:tv_wonder_locked)"
		}
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 6 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type } }
					construct_building = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 5
							owner = prev
						}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type value >= 5 }
						NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type value >= 6 } }
					}
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 1
							owner = prev
						}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type value >= 4 }
						NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type value >= 5 } }

tv_wonder_materialize_module_buildings_from_unit_vars_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type target = var:tv_wonder_locked } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = tv_wonder_module_building_type
				value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type|var:tv_wonder_locked)"
			}
			save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner
			var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								prev = { var:tv_wonder_foundation_units ?= 6 }
								prev = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 0 }
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type } }
						construct_building = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
							change_building_level_in_location = {
								building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type
								value = 5
								owner = prev
							}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 5 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 6 } }
						}
							change_building_level_in_location = {
								building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type
								value = 1
								owner = prev
							}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 4 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 5 } }
						}
							change_building_level_in_location = {
								building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type
								value = 2
								owner = prev
							}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 3 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 4 } }

								building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type

					}
					else_if = {

					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {

								value = -3
								owner = prev
							}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 2 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 3 } }
						}
							change_building_level_in_location = {
								building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type
								value = -2
								owner = prev
							}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 1 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type value >= 2 } }
						}
							change_building_level_in_location = {
								building = local_var:tv_wonder_module_building_type
								value = -1
								owner = prev
							}
					}
				}
			}
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_module_building_type
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_combine_completed_modules_at_location_effect = {
	prev = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner }
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_combine_location
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_modules_combined
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_helper_building_type
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_body_module_building_type
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_function_module_building_type
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_id_to_decoration_module_building_type
		}
		ordered_key_in_global_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_id_to_helper_building_type
			max = 2000
			limit = {
				NOT = { scope:tv_wonder_module_combine_location = { has_variable = tv_wonder_modules_combined } }
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type target = this }
				"global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type|this)" = {
					scope:tv_wonder_module_combine_location = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 1 }
					}
				}
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_body_module_building_type target = this }
				"global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_body_module_building_type|this)" = {
					scope:tv_wonder_module_combine_location = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 1 }
					}
				}
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_function_module_building_type target = this }
				"global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_function_module_building_type|this)" = {
					scope:tv_wonder_module_combine_location = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 1 }
					}
				}
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_id_to_decoration_module_building_type target = this }
				"global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_decoration_module_building_type|this)" = {
					scope:tv_wonder_module_combine_location = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			scope:tv_wonder_module_combine_location = {
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_module_combine_wonder_id value = prev }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_helper_building_type
					value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_helper_building_type|local_var:tv_wonder_module_combine_wonder_id)"
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type
					value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_foundation_module_building_type|local_var:tv_wonder_module_combine_wonder_id)"
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_body_module_building_type
					value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_body_module_building_type|local_var:tv_wonder_module_combine_wonder_id)"
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_function_module_building_type
					value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_function_module_building_type|local_var:tv_wonder_module_combine_wonder_id)"
				}
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type
					value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_id_to_decoration_module_building_type|local_var:tv_wonder_module_combine_wonder_id)"
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type value >= 6 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_body_module_building_type value >= 6 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_function_module_building_type value >= 6 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type value >= 6 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type }
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 6
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}
					}
					else = {
						construct_building = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 5
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}
					}
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type
							value = -6
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_body_module_building_type
							value = -6
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_function_module_building_type
							value = -6
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type
							value = -6
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type value >= 5 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_body_module_building_type value >= 5 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_function_module_building_type value >= 5 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type value >= 5 }
					}

							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 5
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}
					}
					else = {
						construct_building = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 4

						}
					}
						change_building_level_in_location = {

						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_function_module_building_type value >= 4 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type value >= 4 }
					}
					if = {

						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 4

						}
					}

						construct_building = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 3
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner

							value = -4

							building = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type
							value = -4

				else_if = {

						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_body_module_building_type value >= 3 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_function_module_building_type value >= 3 }
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type value >= 3 }

						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_helper_building_type
							value = 2

							building = local_var:tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type
							value = -3

							building = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type
							value = -3
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner

				else_if = {

							value = 1

							value = -2
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner

						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_body_module_building_type
							value = -2

							building = local_var:tv_wonder_function_module_building_type
							value = -2
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}
						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type
							value = -2
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner

							value = -1

						change_building_level_in_location = {
							building = local_var:tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type
							value = -1
							owner = scope:tv_wonder_module_owner
						}

				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_foundation_module_building_type
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_body_module_building_type
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_function_module_building_type
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_decoration_module_building_type
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_helper_building_type
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_module_combine_wonder_id
			}
		}
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_modules_combined
}

tv_wonder_destroy_discovered_generic_intermediate_buildings_at_location_effect = {
	prev = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_module_owner }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_ascetic_mountain
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_theocratic_center
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_body }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_body|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_function }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_function|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_decoration }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_decoration|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sun_king_axis
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_military_city
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_civic_capital
			}
		}

			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_triumphal_axis }

		}

		}

		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_trade_port
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_imperial_naval_port
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_free_trade_metropolis
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_great_port|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_foundation }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_foundation|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}

			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_function|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_decoration }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_great_port_decoration|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_dynastic_necropolis
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_ancestor_shrine
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_quiet_land
			}
		}
		if = {

		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_function }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_giant_necropolis_function|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"

		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_eternal_lighthouse
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_navigator_lighthouse
				has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_long_watch_lighthouse
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_foundation }
			destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse_foundation|scope:tv_wonder_module_owner)"
